scope: Every top-5,000 TUBELEX row that FrequencyPackMappingV2 matches but can't place on one entry after UniDic's readings, on JMdict_e_examp-2026-10-23: 332 rows.
rule: A row is ranked only when it is a content word (a common noun, verb, adjective, or adverb) and Jiten ranks one of the readings UniDic files under its lemma and part of speech at least 10 times above every other, in all seven lists, both spelled as the row and over every spelling UniDic files under that reading; when no expression UniDic splits reads the row another way within 10 times of it, and all such expressions together leave it at least 3 times ahead; when UniDic's own word costs prefer the same reading; and when that reading names one dictionary entry with the row's spelling. A reviewer may still leave a row out, giving the reason.

evidence.ranks: A row's jiten holds, for each reading UniDic files under its lemma and part of speech, Jiten's rank for that reading in each list, in the order of lists: over the row's spelling and the spellings UniDic files under that reading and reads as this word before any other, several spellings' ranks combined as one over the sum of their reciprocals, and null where Jiten didn't observe it. These ranks are adapted from Jiten's lists and are shared under the same licence.

verdicts: Each row's jiten and verdict are what the tool computes from the pinned sources, and a test holds them to it. A verdict's rule is rank or leave; its gate is the first test the row fails (part of speech, readings, margin, own spelling, expression, expressions together, UniDic, or entries), null when it fails none; and it holds what each test it reached measured: the leading reading, the closest other, margin (every list, every spelling), ownSpelling (the row's own spelling), expression (the closest expression UniDic splits; null when there is none), expressions (all of them together), unidic (the reading UniDic's word costs prefer), and entry (the JMdict entry the reading places the row on). A row keeps a reading only when its verdict ranks that reading on that entry; a reviewer may leave out a row the verdict ranks, giving the reason.
